tests.reason: The case needs an existing profile to request, but the tools provide only the admin token, with no way to learn the admin's username or to create a user or profile. The request path requires a username, and none is available in the hints, the case data, or any factory.

The case needs a second, authenticated non-owner user, but the only identity make provides is the admin, and no route in the excerpt creates users. Row TC-C7-1.2 therefore cannot be set up. Making the article owned by someone else would need a user-creation tool, so the binding cannot be written for this case.

The request rules require token=None when REQUEST auth is false, and token=None sends no Authorization header at all, so the request would test anonymous access rather than an empty token header. No available tool sends the empty header, so the case cannot be bound.

tests.reason: This case needs a JWT that is already one hour old. The only tools available are the admin token from make.admin(), name and PDF factories, and API calls. None of them can mint a token with a past issue time or wait out an hour, and sleeping and clocks are forbidden, so no request can be sent with an expired token.

The case needs the request to carry `Authorization: Bearer <valid jwt>`, but the available `api` methods only accept a `token` argument, which sends the admin's credentials in the platform's own scheme. No parameter sets a custom Authorization header or chooses the scheme, so the wrong-scheme request cannot be built with these tools. Passing `token=None` would send no credentials at all, which is a different case.
